grid-min-xs.$description: AutoGrid min="xs": the smallest track before a column drops (chips, small tiles). A grid template reads it, so it has no class of its own.

grid-min-sm.$description: AutoGrid min="sm". A grid template reads it, so it has no class of its own.

grid-min-card.$description: AutoGrid min="card": the design's card track (MenuList, AutoGrid card rows). A grid template reads it, so it has no class of its own.

grid-min-280.$description: TestimonialWall / design 280 card track. A grid template reads it, so it has no class of its own.

grid-min-md.$description: AutoGrid min="md" (default): the card minimum, 260px. A grid template reads it, so it has no class of its own.

grid-min-lg.$description: AutoGrid min="lg": the panel minimum, 320px. A grid template reads it, so it has no class of its own.

grid-min-xl.$description: AutoGrid min="xl". A grid template reads it, so it has no class of its own.

grid-min-2xl.$description: AutoGrid min="2xl". A grid template reads it, so it has no class of its own.
